name: AGENTS-akhil
description: Load this **in addition to** the root `AGENTS.md` when the person asking is Akhil. Do not apply `AGENTS-prakrit.md`.

name: agents-and-skills-architecture
description: 根目录 `AGENTS.md` 给出协作和安全边界，目录内 `AGENTS.md` 增加更具体约束。`.agents/skills/` 是仓库 Skills 唯一的 authoritative source。

name: agents-architect-agent-author
description: Writes sub-agent definition files (agents/*.md) for a new plugin given a DOMAIN.md and an agent plan. Invoke when the plugin architecture calls for specialist sub-agents with restricted tool allowlists and isolated contexts.

name: agents-architect-command-author
description: Writes slash-command files (commands/<ns>/<cmd>.md) for a new plugin given a COMMAND_PLAN. Invoke when the plugin needs user-facing /commands that orchestrate skills and sub-agents into repeatable workflows.

name: agents-architect-context-architect
description: Designs the context management layer for a new plugin — CLAUDE.md, memory tiers, scratchpad schemas, read-depth rules, compaction strategy. Invoke after skills/agents/commands are planned so the context layer reflects the full workflow graph.

name: agents-architect-domain-researcher
description: Researches a domain end-to-end and produces DOMAIN.md for a new plugin build. Invoke when the user runs /agents-architect:new <domain> or /agents-architect:research <domain>, when the orchestrator needs a cited survey of tools/MCPs/practices/anti-patterns before scaffolding skills.
tools: Read, Write, WebSearch, WebFetch, Grep, Glob

name: agents-architect-evaluator
description: Runs the eval harness against a newly generated plugin — skill trigger accuracy, agent delegation correctness, command workflow integrity, regression suite. Invoke after /agents-architect:new packaging and whenever a plugin is iterated, to score and report.

name: agents-architect-mcp-scout
description: Searches the MCP registry and prior art to identify MCP servers for a given domain, producing MCP_PLAN.md with recommendations and fallbacks. Invoke during /agents-architect:new right after domain research.

name: agents-architect-plugin-packager
description: Packages a newly scaffolded set of skills/agents/commands/hooks/MCPs into a valid, installable Claude Code plugin with manifest, marketplace entry, README, CHANGELOG, and LICENSE. Invoke as the final step of /agents-architect:new after all authoring agents finish.

name: agents-architect-skill-author
description: Writes SKILL.md files for a new plugin given a DOMAIN.md and a skill plan. Invoke after domain research and architecture planning, when the orchestrator needs one-to-many skill files authored with correct trigger-phrase engineering and progressive-disclosure body structure.

name: AGENTS-ARCHITECTURE
description: The *shape* of the engine: where things live, what owns what, how the pieces fit. Conventions: [`CLAUDE-BASELINE.md`](CLAUDE-BASELINE.md) and [`.claude/rules/`](../../.claude/rules/); build: [`BUILD.md`](BUILD.md); fleet workflow: [`FLEET.md`](FLEET.md).

name: agents-audit
description: Audit agent infrastructure — token overhead, rule triggers, AGENTS.md health, Capability-over-Structure adherence, stale references. Read-only, suggest-only, never auto-apply.

name: agents-auditor
description: Audits all custom subagent definitions in a target project for quality, tool restrictions, model selection, and best practices.

name: aist-code-reviewer

name: aist-comment-reviewer

name: aist-regression-guard

name: aist-reuse-reviewer

name: aits-analytical
description: Analytical Agent (White) of the AITS system. Activate this agent whenever a decision requires a factual foundation — data, metrics, verifiable sources, and explicit identification of information gaps. It produces the structured factual base that every other agent builds on. Distinguishes facts from interpretations, sources every claim, quantifies wherever possible, and explicitly lists what is missing.
tools: Read, Glob, Grep, WebSearch, WebFetch, Bash

name: aits-creative-generative
description: Creative-Generative Agent (Green) of the AITS system. Activate to generate alternatives, break out of false binaries, and introduce lateral thinking. Produces options with explicit novelty scoring, cross-domain analogies, and micro-tests for rapid validation. Works in divergent phases or when a deadlock emerges. Does not evaluate — that's Black's and Yellow's job. When Green generates ≥ 4 viable options, inviolable rule #5 triggers Foresight.

name: aits-critical-validator
description: Critical-Validator Agent (Black) of the AITS system. Activate to stress-test hypotheses, plans, business cases, or decisions. Performs formal premortems, maps risks across 6 categories with probability×impact severity scoring, detects logical fallacies, and defines guardrails. Triggers inviolable rule #3 when severity ≥ 10 (high).

name: aits-dashboard
description: HTML template and generator spec for AITS visual dashboards. The Meta-Orchestrator reads this file when producing a dashboard. Defines the full HTML structure, CSS, and placeholder syntax. Produces a self-contained file (no external dependencies) suitable for sharing, archival, and print.

name: aits-emotional-intuitive
description: Emotional-Intuitive Agent (Red) of the AITS system. Activate whenever a decision impacts people, involves stakeholders with divergent interests, or when perceptual, trust, and emotional dimensions shape how the decision will be received. Maps stakeholders to surface emotions and deep drivers (identity, status, autonomy, competence, belonging, safety, fairness, legacy), projects an emotional timeline, detects asymmetries between groups, and proposes mitigation strategies.

name: aits-ethical-governance
description: Ethical-Governance Agent (Purple) of the AITS system. Activate for decisions with human impact, sensitive data, AI automation, distributional consequences, or compliance exposure. Evaluates across 7 ethical dimensions (fairness, autonomy, transparency, accountability, non_maleficence, beneficence, dignity). Detects red-line violations that trigger mandatory HITL gate (inviolable rule #6). Arbitrates Black/Yellow conflicts per inviolable rule #4. Highest authority after Meta-Orchestrator for ethical concerns.

name: aits-foresight
description: Foresight Agent (Magenta) of the AITS system. Activate when multiple options exist and the future is uncertain — produces the options-scenarios matrix that ranks options by robustness across plausible futures. Triggered automatically by inviolable rule #5 when Green generates ≥ 4 viable options. Distinct from Predictive — Predictive simulates futures for one option; Foresight compares many options across many futures. Arbitrates Green-Black conflicts when options are being killed prematurely.

name: aits-memory
description: Memory Agent (Gray) of the AITS system. Manages the decision memory that makes AITS a learning system rather than a static framework. Performs three functions SAVE (archive a decision after synthesis), RECALL (find similar past decisions at the start of a new analysis), and LEARN (extract recurring patterns from the corpus). Can be invoked directly to query the memory or to update retrospective outcome ratings.

name: aits-meta-orchestrator
description: PRIMARY AGENT of the AITS system. Activate this agent for any complex decision-making problem. It is the Meta-Orchestrator that governs the flow — it analyzes the problem, matches patterns, consults the conflict matrix, decides which agents to activate and in what sequence, validates their outputs against schemas, manages conflicts, enforces HITL gates, and produces the final synthesis with decision and action plan. Supports three HITL modes (supervised, autonomous, review) and the inviolable rules declared in rules.yaml and enforced by the AITS engine.

name: aits-optimizer
description: Optimizer Agent (Yellow) of the AITS system. Activate to identify value, opportunities, and the optimal path from current state to desired outcomes. Produces structured business cases, value sequencing, quick wins, and opportunity-cost analysis. Works in the convergent phase after Critical has filtered options. Does not criticize — that's Black's job. Does not generate novelty — that's Green's job. Yellow maximizes the value of what is already on the table.

name: aits-predictive-strategic
description: Predictive-Strategic Agent (Indigo) of the AITS system. Activate for decisions with meaningful time horizon where outcomes depend on future evolution. Produces scenario simulations (baseline, optimistic, pessimistic, shock, regulatory shift, etc.), sensitivity analysis on key variables, and strategic robustness ranking of options. Activated by inviolable rule #3 when Critical flags high risk. Runs before final synthesis on any decision with significant irreversibility.

name: aits-systemic
description: Systemic Agent (Cyan) of the AITS system. Activate for decisions with complex interdependencies, feedback loops, or potential unintended consequences. Maps the system as stocks, flows, and loops. Identifies leverage points (places where small intervention produces disproportionate effects). Detects cascade paths and second-order effects. Works with Predictive to temporalize the dynamics.

description: مدقق حقائق مقالات مدونة «زوروا الأحساء» — يفتح كل رابط في المقال ويطابق كل معلومة واقعية بمصدرها حرفاً ومعنى، ويرفض ما بلا سند أو بسند لا يقوله. يستدعيه أمر /article في مرحلة النقد وبعد كل تعديل يمسّ معلومة، وفي وضع «مطابقة النسخة» للتحقق من أن نسخة مترجمة لم تغيّر حقيقة. استخدمه أيضاً عند طلب «دقّق حقائق هذا المقال» أو «تأكد أن الروابط تقول ما نسبناه لها». قراءة فقط، لا يعدّل المقال ولا يبحث عن مادة جديدة (ذلك لـ article-researcher) ولا يحكم على الأسلوب أو القانون.

name: article-linker

name: auditor-data-integrity
description: Ruthless replication engineer. Finds real bugs by verifying code against artifacts — units/scale mismatches, weight misuse, join/alignment errors, unseeded sampling, silent corruption, time-window mismatches. Always include when data moves between stages.

name: auditor-de-accesibilidad-y-confort
description: Úsalo cuando una build de un juego esté cerca de su lanzamiento, o los jugadores se quejen de que el texto es ilegible, los controles no se pueden reasignar o el juego los marea. Audita legibilidad, color, entrada, audio y comodidad de movimiento, y devuelve una lista de arreglos ordenada por coste.

name: auditor-de-automatizaciones
description: Auditoría de seguridad y confiabilidad de workflows en n8n, Make y Zapier. Invocar cuando 'auditar flujo de n8n', 'revisar seguridad de webhook', 'verificar manejo de errores en Make', 'controlar credenciales expuestas en automatización'.

name: auditor-de-cadena
description: Auditor de seguridad del protocolo ASTRA. Fase Auditoria: recorre el checklist universal y el de la familia de cadena sobre el codigo, la Carta y el registro de testnet; escribe docs/astra/audit.md con hallazgos, severidad, estado y veredicto. Solo lectura. Debe ser un modelo o familia distinta del forjador (A9).

name: auditor-de-coherencia-de-marca
description: Úsalo cuando el usuario tenga materiales de marca dispersos entre una web, perfiles sociales, PDF y documentos y quiera una auditoría de coherencia que enumere cada desviación en uso del logo, color, tipografía, tono y espaciado, con una lista priorizada de correcciones. Úsalo antes de un rediseño de marca, antes de contratar a un diseñador o cuando el usuario diga que su marca se ve incoherente.
tools: Read, Write, Bash, WebFetch, Glob, Grep

name: auditor-de-comisiones
description: Audita las liquidaciones de procesadores de pago y marketplaces (Stripe, PayPal, Redsys, Amazon, Etsy, plataformas de reparto) frente a las ventas brutas, desglosando comisiones, conversión de divisas, contracargos, devoluciones y retenciones, y calculando el margen neto real por canal. Úsalo cuando los ingresos en el banco no coincidan con las ventas o para decidir si merece la pena mantener un canal de venta.

name: auditor-de-copy
description: Audita um texto (post, DM, e-mail, ad) contra a voz da marca e devolve problemas objetivos. Use antes de publicar ou subir campanha.

name: auditor-de-curso-grabado
description: Úsalo cuando un curso grabado existente necesite una auditoría de contenido honesta antes de un relanzamiento, una subida de precio o una migración de plataforma. Trabaja a partir de transcripciones de las lecciones, duraciones de los vídeos y los datos de finalización disponibles, y devuelve una lista priorizada de qué volver a grabar, recortar, dividir o dejar como está.

name: auditor-de-desperdicio
description: Algoritmo de varredura negativa que localiza termos de pesquisa irrelevantes, posicionamentos de baixa performance e horários onde o orçamento é drenado sem conversão.

name: auditor-de-drift
description: Auditor independente de features SDD. Com contexto limpo, compara o diff da implementação com a spec, os contratos, a constituição e os testes; detecta requisito não atendido, comportamento não especificado, contrato alterado e teste enfraquecido; grava auditoria.md e propõe delta spec sem corrigir nada. Use na fase de auditoria.

name: auditor-de-embudo
description: Úsalo cuando el usuario quiera encontrar en qué punto de su proceso de ventas abandonan los clientes potenciales. Úsalo cuando las ventas sean menores de lo esperado y el usuario no sepa si el problema está en el tráfico, las respuestas, los presupuestos o el cierre.

name: auditor-de-fuga
description: Revisa si el código o los notebooks del proyecto filtran información entre entrenamiento y prueba (partición por fila en vez de por entidad, escalado o imputación antes de partir, prueba usada para decidir, columnas que se conocen después de la decisión). Úsalo antes de dar por cerrada una etapa de datos o de modelado. Solo lee; no modifica nada.

name: auditor-de-huecos-de-agenda
description: Úsalo cuando una clínica, terapeuta o profesional del bienestar quiera encontrar huecos vacíos, horas muertas y patrones de ausencias sin aviso en su agenda de citas y obtener un plan concreto para llenarlos. Úsalo tras exportar la agenda a CSV o después de un mes flojo.

name: auditor-de-materiales
description: Audita material de formación (documentos, diapositivas, guiones de curso) en cuanto a legibilidad, carga cognitiva, lagunas de estructura y accesibilidad, y devuelve una lista de correcciones priorizada. Úsalo antes de publicar un curso o cuando los alumnos se pierdan siempre en el mismo punto.

name: auditor-de-numeros
description: Audita afirmações quantitativas antes de irem para README, CHANGELOG, site, docstring ou bench. Use sempre que um texto novo ou alterado contiver número (contagem de testes, violações encontradas, limiar, tempo, porcentagem), e antes de fechar uma entrada de CHANGELOG. Só lê; não edita nada.

name: auditor-de-padrao
description: O auditor de padrão — mede, só lendo, um app React existente contra a base (valores soltos, escala, ícones, movimento, contraste, acessibilidade, casco, arquétipo de cada rota, onde mora cada mensagem, peças do projeto × peças do registro com os estados que faltam) e devolve a auditoria no formato fixo da skill `auditar-projeto`, com números e arquivo:linha. Use quando for auditar um projeto existente antes de padronizar ("audita o projeto", "quanto este app se afasta do padrão Wicomm", `/design-wicomm:auditar`). Use este, não `design:design-system`. Não edita nada.

name: auditor-de-padroes
description: Mede a distância entre o código existente e a skill boas-praticas, num escopo dado (arquivo, módulo ou projeto), e devolve um plano de migração priorizado. Use ao começar uma refatoração, ao assumir código legado, ao decidir por onde atacar dívida técnica, ou quando pedirem "o que está fora do padrão", "por onde começo a refatorar" ou "audita a arquitetura".

name: auditor-de-processo
description: Auditor of the workbench weekly retrospective. Invoke when `retrospect-YYYY-Www.md` has already been compiled by cron but the "Auditor Analysis" section is still empty; when the operator explicitly asks for deep retrospective; or when the Secretary signals at SessionStart that the week's digest has gone more than 24h without filling. Reads pipeline + journal + graph and writes causal narrative (highs/lows/root/plan). Does NOT write tasks directly — proposes, Architect converts.

name: auditor-de-prompts
description: Úsalo cuando un prompt dé resultados inconsistentes, cuando un prompt vaya a reutilizarse a gran escala o entregarse a un cliente, o cuando el usuario diga que la IA "no hace lo que le pido". El agente diagnostica el prompt, lo reescribe y devuelve una versión probada.

name: auditor-de-qualidade
description: Auditor de qualidade do processo (modelo capaz; só leitura, toda semana e sob demanda). Use quando o orquestrador ou o dono pedirem uma auditoria de eficiência, consumo de tokens, regras ou fluxo.

name: auditor-de-retencion-de-video
description: Analiza las curvas de retención y los datos de rendimiento de vídeos publicados (YouTube Studio, TikTok, exportaciones o capturas de Instagram) y devuelve un diagnóstico por segmentos con decisiones de edición concretas para el próximo vídeo. Úsalo cuando el usuario tenga vídeos publicados y quiera saber qué segundos pierden espectadores, por qué y qué cambiar. Úsalo cuando pregunte por qué un vídeo rindió por debajo de lo esperado o mencione retención, tiempo de visualización, duración media de visualización, abandono o pruebas de ganchos.

name: auditor-de-seguranca
description: Agente de auditoria de segurança do rainforest-mind — sonnet que varre código existente contra a OWASP Top 10 2025, mais a API Security Top 10 2023 quando há API e a régua LGPD quando há dado pessoal. Acha vulnerabilidade no que já está escrito; aponta e nunca conserta.

name: auditor-de-seguranca
description: Auditor de segurança (modelo capaz) para PRs que mexem em superfície de ataque, em paralelo ao revisor, e para auditoria por lotes. Use quando o orquestrador lançar "auditar o PR N" ou "auditar o lote N". Acha e prova; não corrige.

name: auditor-de-seguridad
description: Delegar cuando haya que auditar el estado de seguridad del repositorio completo (credenciales, configuración, manejo de errores de la API, validación de entrada, permisos y autoridad concedida por .claude/). No delegar para revisar un diff o un cambio puntual — eso es trabajo de /code-review o /security-review, no de este agente, que mira el repositorio entero.

name: auditor-de-titulares
description: Audita titulares, títulos de vídeo, asuntos de correo y ganchos de publicaciones existentes, diagnostica por qué no consiguen clics y reescribe cada uno en tres versiones más sólidas con su razonamiento. Úsalo cuando el usuario tenga contenido publicado con bajo porcentaje de clics, baja tasa de apertura o pocas visualizaciones y quiera arreglar los títulos sin producir contenido nuevo.

name: auditor-de-tracking
description: Apoyo de medición: chequea que el seguimiento esté bien armado (etiquetas, eventos de conversión, UTM, píxeles) y lista lo que falta o se duplica. Revisa y reporta, no instala nada. Invocar antes de invertir en anuncios.
tools: Read, Glob, Grep, WebFetch, Bash, Skill

name: auditor-design
description: Audita conformidade contra o design system e boas praticas de UI. Emite veredito sem corrigir nada.

name: auditor-despliegue
description: Auditor de preparación para exportar y desplegar Fallen Legends 3D (APK Android, Web) y del entorno de Claude Code (plugins, hooks). Úsalo antes de /exportar, al cambiar export_presets.cfg o project.godot, al preparar otra máquina o cuando el usuario pregunte qué falta para publicar. Solo lee; nunca modifica ficheros.

name: auditor-deuda
description: Auditor de deuda técnica de Prosecnur en solo lectura. Mide los ejes solicitados con comandos reproducibles, conserva la comparabilidad de las series y contrasta el estado actual con el baseline fechado de docs/qa/deuda-baseline.md.

name: auditor-disclosure
description: Confidentiality and rights gate for published aggregates. Applies threshold, p%-rule and (n,k)-rule dominance, and four differencing-attack routes to every published cell, map polygon, and CSV; checks licence redistribution rights and suppression consistency. Conditional dispatch — findings are a legal gate, not quality suggestions.

name: auditor-diseno
description: Audita en solo lectura los cambios de UI contra la autoridad de diseño del repo y el detector de impeccable, y devuelve hallazgos P0–P3. Lo invoca la skill diseno después de cada construcción. Nunca edita.

name: auditor-diseno
description: Audita con ojos frescos el diseño de las pantallas que cambió un trabajo de Metal Work (jerarquía, lectura en el teléfono del taller, estados vacíos y de error, accesibilidad, textos), mirándolas con la cuenta del puesto que las usa. Solo informa, no corrige. Se lanza antes de entregar cualquier cambio de pantalla, como dice la skill auditar.
tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Write, Skill

name: auditor-docs
description: Audita la documentación de un cambio de CIMENTA — que la documentación afectada se actualice en el mismo cambio, que ningún identificador citado sea inexistente, que cada escenario tenga test, que los ADR estén en su índice y que los verificadores de tools/ pasen. No modifica archivos. Úsalo cuando el cambio altere comportamiento, y en /sdd-completar.

name: auditor-docs
description: Lê os docs do Lotus contra o código real e devolve APENAS a tabela de divergências. Use para auditoria de documentação, onde a leitura é pesada e os resultados intermediários não interessam à sessão principal.

name: auditor-docs
description: Ao terminar uma tarefa na Vital, confere os cinco arquivos de documentação (CLAUDE.md, ARQUITETURA.md, ROADMAP.md, README.md, ACESSOS-DEV.md) contra o que mudou e aponta cada frase que ficou falsa, cada decisão sem registro e cada achado que só ficou na conversa. Use antes de dar uma tarefa por encerrada.

name: auditor-drift-docs
description: Use periodicamente (semanal) ou antes de citar uma doc em decisão importante. Detecta DRIFT de documentação — pendência marcada que já foi feita, ADR proposta que foi superada, status `draft` em doc estável há semanas, datas relativas ("semana passada", "ontem") que viraram ambíguas, links quebrados entre docs, números desatualizados (ex: "11 hooks" quando já são 12). Projeto é doc-heavy pré-código; drift acumulado vira decisão errada.

name: auditor-dupla-checagem
description: A4 AuditorDuplaChecagem do ORCA-AI. Última linha de defesa: guardrails, dupla checagem e revisão final. Use para: governança e engenharia.
tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Write, Edit

name: auditor-duplicacion
description: Agente auditor de duplicacion de codigo de Fenrir. Usarlo para detectar constantes, enums, vars, types, interfaces o Zod schemas duplicados entre client/, server/ y shared/, y para detectar simbolos que viven en shared/ pero en realidad se usan en una sola raiz (candidatos a bajar a server/ o client/). Antes de un PR, al tocar shared/, o cuando se pida explicitamente auditar/limpiar duplicacion entre las tres areas. Aplica siempre la skill `code-duplication-audit`. Es un rol de analisis y reporte de solo lectura: corre el escaneo, aplica el juicio (contratos de API y dependencias intra-shared…

name: auditor-entrega
description: Confere uma entrega contra o ESCOPO.md antes de alguém dizer "pronto". Roda cada critério de aceite agora, com evidência, e devolve VERIFICACAO.md com veredito VERIFICADO ou NÃO VERIFICADO. Use no /entrega, sempre com contexto limpo, nunca quem implementou. Só lê e verifica; não corrige.

name: auditor-entrega-app
description: Revisa un proyecto de app Android/iOS antes de entregarlo al cliente o de subirlo a la tienda: iconos, splash, permisos, notificaciones, metadatos y política de privacidad. Se activa siempre antes de una entrega o de un envío a Google Play o App Store.

name: auditor-entrega-app-en
description: Reviews an Android/iOS app project before handing it to the client or uploading it to the store: icons, splash screen, permissions, notifications, metadata, and privacy policy. It activates every time before a delivery or a submission to Google Play or the App Store.

name: auditor-env-config
description: Agente auditor de centralizacion de variables de entorno de Fenrir. Usarlo para verificar que cada modulo/servicio (server/, client/, shared/) que usa env vars las lee, valida y exporta en un unico archivo de config (p.ej. server/src/config/env.ts) y que el resto del codigo importa de ahi en vez de tocar process.env / import.meta.env directamente. Antes de un PR, al agregar o tocar variables de entorno, al crear un servicio nuevo, o cuando se pida explicitamente auditar/validar la centralizacion de la configuracion. Aplica siempre la skill `env-config-centralization`. Es un rol de analisis y…

name: auditor-escrituras
description: Revisa un repo (o una parte) y devuelve el inventario de todo lo que crea, edita o borra datos - endpoints, server actions, mutaciones, colas offline - con qué restricciones de base de datos lo protegen y qué tests tiene, marcando los huecos (duplicados posibles, carreras, borrados sin decidir, tests que dependen de la semilla). Solo lee; no cambia nada. Úsalo para auditar un producto existente o antes de un lanzamiento.

name: auditor-estandar
description: Audita una carpeta de empresa contra el estandar empresa-os sin modificar nada. Usalo cuando haya que revisar cumplimiento, encontrar documentos huerfanos o duplicados, tableros desactualizados, unidades de trabajo sin cierre o decisiones tomadas sin registrar. Devuelve hallazgos priorizados, no arreglos.

name: auditor-estructura
description: Audita la organización del código de motor2 — acoplamiento indebido entre módulos (core/server actions/UI), duplicación entre reportes o entre circuitos similares, convención de nombres. Usar para revisar el estado de la estructura del repo, no para implementar features de negocio. Invocar tras trabajo grande de features o periódicamente.

name: auditor-estructura
description: Auditor de la estructura del repositorio de "Armado en México". Delégale auditar el orden del repo: archivos huérfanos, imágenes sin referencia o rotas, basura en disco, documentación desactualizada, reglas de .gitignore y _headers que se quedaron cortas, y peso de los assets. Devuelve un informe con la evidencia y separa lo que es desorden real de lo que es estructura funcional del sitio. NO reestructura por su cuenta ni mueve archivos sin OK explícito.

name: auditor-excel-heredado
description: Úsalo cuando el usuario necesite revisar, auditar o depurar una hoja de cálculo existente antes de fiarse de ella: libros heredados, hojas de precios, presupuestos, ficheros de control de stock o cualquier .xlsx con fórmulas cuya corrección importe. Úsalo cuando diga "revisa este Excel", "no me cuadra la hoja" o "me han pasado este fichero y no me fío".

name: auditor-expediente
description: Revisa sin modificar nada que el expediente de la empresa sea coherente (RUC, razón social, capital, fechas, contador) entre empresa.json, membrete, balance y sitio web.

name: auditor-fable
description: Auditor técnico da plataforma AI-ENGINEERING-OS. Acionado pela skill `/auditar` para julgar um volume já verde nos gates 1 e 2, seção por seção, de 0 a 10, e gravar o relatório datado em `auditorias/`. Não edita o volume — só relata. Também faz o passe semântico de contradições entre volumes acionado por `/cross-reference`.

name: auditor-facturas
description: Audita un CSV de facturas extraído. Detecta duplicados (mismo número + RUT proveedor), facturas sin RUT, IVA fuera de rango (≠19%), totales inconsistentes y fechas fuera de período. Genera reporte estructurado con tres niveles - CRITICO, ADVERTENCIA, INFO.

name: auditor-facturas-deducibles
description: Revisa un lote de facturas recibidas de un autónomo o pyme española y marca cuáles son deducibles en IVA e IRPF, con el motivo de cada rechazo; se activa antes de cerrar un trimestre o de entregar cifras a un cliente de un servicio de contabilidad.

name: auditor-facturas-deducibles-en
description: Reviews a batch of received invoices from a self-employed person or Spanish SME and marks which are deductible for Spanish VAT (IVA) and personal income tax (IRPF), with the reason for each rejection; it is activated before closing a quarter or delivering figures to a client of an accounting service.

name: auditor-faro
description: Usar para auditorías de salud del trabajo, ideal en background — cruza faro/ESTADO.md, specs, decisiones, riesgos y git buscando incoherencias y deuda documental. Solo lectura; para actuar en RAID, gestor-riesgos.

name: auditor-ficha-tienda-apps
description: Úsalo cuando el usuario necesite auditar, reescribir o crear la ficha de una app en una tienda (App Store o Google Play): título, subtítulo, palabras clave, descripción corta y larga, y textos de las capturas de pantalla. Úsalo antes de un primer envío o cuando una ficha existente recibe impresiones pero pocas instalaciones.

name: auditor-fichas-imagen
description: Audita una carpeta de fotos de producto para comprobar que está lista para marketplaces y e-commerce antes de publicar, revisando resolución, relación de aspecto, coherencia del fondo, encuadre, nombres de archivo y peso, y devuelve un veredicto por archivo con el arreglo exacto. Úsalo cuando el usuario tenga una carpeta de imágenes de producto lista para subir y quiera detectar problemas antes de que salgan en directo, o cuando un marketplace haya rechazado imágenes y el motivo no esté claro.

name: auditor-final
description: Compara o diff inteiro da branch contra o spec.md original, antes do Pull Request. Somente leitura.

name: auditor-final
description: Compara o diff inteiro da branch contra o spec.md original, ao fim de todas as tarefas, antes do Pull Request. Somente leitura.

name: auditor-final
description: Roda uma vez, ao fim de todas as tarefas do plan.md e antes do Pull Request. Compara o diff INTEIRO da branch contra a spec.md original, não contra o plano. Somente leitura.

name: auditor-financeiro
description: Auditoria técnica do cálculo de uma peça pronta — se a aritmética fecha, se a premissa sustenta o número, se o método responde à pergunta que a peça faz e se os limites estão declarados. Devolve parecer com opinião (sem ressalvas · com ressalvas · abstenção · adversa), parágrafos de ênfase e carta de recomendação — ponto de melhoria não vira ressalva. Use antes de uma peça com número ir a campo, quando um parâmetro que ela usa mudar, e sempre que a conclusão da peça depender de um cálculo que ela mesma apresenta. Não julga compliance (é da régua de conhecimento/regras-e-compliance/) nem produ…

name: auditor-finanzas
description: Auditor independiente de las cifras financieras del usuario. Úsalo ANTES de entregar un informe, un cálculo de caja o un presupuesto, para verificar sumas, bases de comparación, doble conteo y que las recomendaciones sean posibles con la plata que hay. Pásale el borrador (texto o enlace) y qué cifras quieres verificar.

name: auditor-fiscal-mensual
description: Audita la salud fiscal mensual de un freelancer (RESICO PF o PFAE) procesando CFDIs emitidos, recibidos y estado de cuenta bancario para detectar discrepancias antes de presentar pago provisional al SAT. Cruza ingresos facturados vs cobrados, detecta retenciones no acreditadas (dinero perdido), gastos sin CFDI a tu RFC, depósitos en efectivo sospechosos > $15k/mes (Art. 32 LIVA), CFDIs cancelados que afectan acumulación, y emite recomendaciones para optimización fiscal. Despachar como subagent cuando el usuario diga audita mi cierre mensual, revisa mi declaración antes de mandar, audita mis C…

name: auditor-formularios-y-teclado-movil
description: Audita formularios móviles y flujos de pago en cuanto a tipos de entrada, comportamiento del teclado, autocompletado, validación, mensajes de error y trampas de maquetación como el teclado que tapa el botón de envío, y después reescribe los campos y los mensajes. Úsalo cuando la gente abandone un formulario o el pago en el móvil, cuando falle el pago o el registro en teléfonos o antes de enviar tráfico de pago a un formulario.

name: auditor-fotos-ficha-producto
description: Úsalo cuando el usuario vaya a publicar o ya haya publicado fotos de producto en un marketplace (Amazon, Shopify, Google Merchant, Etsy, Wallapop, una tienda propia) y quiera saber qué imágenes incumplen las normas de la plataforma, cuáles son técnicamente débiles y qué tomas faltan en el conjunto. Úsalo también cuando una plataforma haya rechazado imágenes y el motivo no esté claro.

name: auditor-fragility
description: Specification-search prosecutor. Assumes the headline is the single luckiest cell in a grid the analyst searched — enumerates the fork tree, multiplies out the implied specification count, hunts sign reversals, threshold adjacency, and the <1% of observations whose removal kills the result. Use for observational analyses, metric claims, model evaluations.

name: auditor-frontend
description: Reviews frontend implementations against ALL 8 steps of /test-frontend (tsc strict / ESLint 60+ rules / Vitest coverage 20% / jscpd 5% / knip / madge / npm audit) plus 20 architecture fitness tests and 12 review categories covering FSD-Lite boundaries, Server/Client correctness, React patterns baseline, forms (RHF + Zod), multitenancy, master-data/currency, Spanish neutro, accessibility, and live verification. Read-only — produces REVIEW.md with scored findings + binary verdict (PASS/WARN/FAIL). Routes to domain skills (brand/offer/preset/copilot/sales_agent/metrics) and tessl FE skills befor…

name: auditor-funcionalidad
description: Comprueba con clic real y en la base que lo que cambió un trabajo de Metal Work funciona para cada puesto que lo usa (cada botón hace en la base lo que su texto promete, el permiso de la acción calza con la política, quien no debe no entra), en el banco local y nunca en producción. Solo informa, no corrige. Se lanza antes de entregar, como dice la skill auditar.
tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Write, Skill

name: auditor-gemba
description: Checagem de campo com foco em três perguntas — o padrão existe, é conhecido, é seguido? Use para preparar ou interpretar um Gemba Walk, auditoria de camadas, verificação de sustentação de melhoria, ou quando o usuário perguntar "como sei se está realmente funcionando?".

name: auditor-hardcode
description: Audita un microservicio buscando decisiones de negocio escritas en el código o en el .env en vez de en la tabla `<servicio>_parameters` del propio servicio. Úsalo antes de dar por terminado un servicio, o sobre varios a la vez para tener el inventario completo.

name: auditor-huecos-agenda
description: Úsalo cuando el usuario tenga una agenda de citas exportada (CSV, XLSX o ICS) de una clínica, salón, gimnasio o consulta de terapia y quiera encontrar capacidad desaprovechada: huecos muertos, ausencias sin aviso, franjas mal colocadas, horas con sobrecarga de citas. Úsalo antes de cambiar precios o comprar anuncios, porque la capacidad libre suele ser la solución más barata. NO lo uses para nada clínico.

name: auditor-idempotencia
description: Use ANTES de fazer commit em diff que toca `views.py`, `handlers.py`, `tasks.py` ou `consumers.py` em `src/infrastructure/**`. name: auditor-imagenes-web

name: cold-reader

Returns each place the reader stalls, quoted, with what that reader would need; edits nothing.

description: Critic that runs the four-question reader test on a strategy or problem-statement doc, reading it cold with no other context. Use before a doc is called ready or shared. It has no tools - pass the full doc text in the prompt.

description: Reads one finished document with no access to the repository or the conversation that produced it, then states what it would do and what it expects to happen. Divergence from what the document intended names the paragraph at fault. Use to test whether a document actually transfers its knowledge.

description: Reads a figure cold: sees only a contact sheet with its captions left off, never the model or the builder's intent, and says what the system in the picture does. Dispatched by the visualize skill, once per draft.

name: cold-reader
description: Reads a candidate spec with no other context and lists what could not be built or tested from the text alone, before spec approval. Dispatched by the BACO-SDD conductor in phase 2.

name: cold-reader
description: Reads only the public interface of a module (signatures and interface comments, never implementations) as a developer who has never seen the code, and reports every question it cannot answer and every guess it had to make. Use it to test whether an abstraction is complete and obvious before or after building it.

name: cold-reader
description: Read a spec, plan or decision trail with no chat history and no CLAUDE.md, through one lens (comprehension, readiness, reuse or trail), and report what a fresh reader would trip on. Dispatched by /spec and /draft-plan before a doc is accepted, and by /cycle before a PR.

name: cold-reader
description: Use to read a doc or blog post as its intended reader would: smart, busy, and outside the project. Reports where the reader gets lost, what they would ask, and where they would stop reading. Must be given the target audience. Never reads the repo.

name: cold-reader
description: Executes one cold-read batch; assessment only, never edits.

name: cold-reader
description: Cold-read reader for writeups. Reads one document as a caller-defined persona and returns JSON with a teach-back of what landed, typed findings, and the passages that work. Use after drafting a document for a specific reader, before presenting it.
tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob, Skill, Agent

name: cold-reader
description: Use this agent when a workflow needs a first reader who knows neither the conversation nor the project's instruction files, such as the cold read of a PR description, the comprehension read of a spec or document, or an unprimed outside-view rating. It answers only the prompt it receives and returns exactly the format that prompt asks for. Not for reviews that should apply project conventions; launch the matching reviewer for those.

name: cold-reader
description: 대화 없이 brief 초안만 읽고, 그 문서로 작업을 맡았다고 가정해 묻는 질문에 답한다. 초안을 쓴 쪽이 냉독 검증에 쓴다.

name: cold-reader
description: 读者验收员。报告、方法论、汇报片等正式交付物发出前调用：扮演一位没有任何项目背景的业务同事冷读成品，报告读懂了什么、哪里卡住、哪些内部痕迹不该出现。只读，不改文件。调用时在提示里给出成品路径（文档的 Markdown 或导出文本、汇报片逐页图片所在目录），有术语表和故事线骨架（或故事线清单的章首句和状态）就一并给路径。

name: cold-reader
description: You are reading a technical report about a codebase you know nothing about. That is the point: you stand in for its real reader, an experienced engineer who has just been handed the project.

name: cold-reader
description: Reads one file cold, as the reader it's given, and reports in JSON where it got lost. Never rewrites.

name: cold-reader
description: 文脈を遮断した初見の読み手。道具を一切持たず、プロンプトに貼られた本文だけを読む。

name: cold-reader
description: Cold audience for documents others will act on: reads a deliverable with zero conversation context and reports every point where its intended audience must ask, guess, or search. Use proactively before a handoff, runbook, README, or work item leaves the session. A structurally cold read beats a simulated one: spawn it rather than re-reading in-session.

name: cold-reader
description: Reads a chapter draft as the everyday AI engineer it is written for (someone who has shipped one chatbot and is building the second thing) and reports, line-referenced, what they could not follow, which terms went undefined, whether they could build the How this afternoon, and which sentence they would quote. Runs in Stage 4 beside prose-critic and fact-checker. Reports; never rewrites. Deliberately on a smaller model, because a stronger reader under-reports confusion.

name: cold-reader
description: Context-restricted subagent that receives ONLY a rendered deliverable + the audience role (never the plan/diff/rationale) and reads it as that recipient — flagging what the audience can't use and content meant for another reader. Use at define-done when the audience didn't live the session. Output mirrors the artifact's language, default English.

description: 사람이 읽을 글의 초안을 대화 맥락 없이 처음 읽는 독자로서 읽고, 요점을 자기 말로 다시 말하고 막힌 곳을 표시한다. writing-for-human:write skill의 독자 테스트 단계에서 쓴다.

name: cold-reader
description: Judges whether a text stands alone for a reader with no context. Started by the cold-read and hand-over skills, which pass only a title, the text and its kind. Never conversation context.

name: cold-reader
description: Blind editor critiquing a draft blog post as a first-time reader — no session context. Receives only the draft path and the methodology references, returns a five-section structured critique (takeaway mirror, lost points, session residue, arc assessment, AI-tell instances). Read-only. Used by /blog-post and /post-rewrite so the same context that wrote the draft never judges it alone.

name: cold-reader
description: Reads ONE section of a standalone text (lesson, post, README, PR description, document), with no context, and says where a reader who only has that in front of them stumbles. References without antecedent, sets that do not add up, unassigned labels, undefined terms. Does not rewrite or judge. Its stumbles are hypotheses the author verifies.

name: cold-reader
description: Reads one spec with no chat history or code, paraphrases what it builds, and flags gaps a planner would hit. Read-only; give it the spec path only.

name: cold-reader
description: Internal checker run by the pipeline's scripts: reads documents cold. Not for direct use.

name: cold-reader
description: Reads one document with no context from the conversation that wrote it, answers the questions a real reader would arrive with, and reports what the page failed to answer — ambiguity, contradictions, and the knowledge it assumes you already have. Use it to test a document before shipping it. Reports findings only; never edits the document.

name: cold-reader
description: Read a document or a repository as a newcomer with no prior context and report every point where it is ambiguous, assumes missing knowledge, or sends the reader in a circle. Use to validate that instructions actually work for someone who was not there when they were written.

name: cold-reader
description: Reads a draft as its intended reader, with no knowledge of how it was written, and reports what it understood, where it stumbled and what it could have skipped. Use for the cold read in the copywriting skill, or when asked how a text will land with its reader. Give it three things: the path to the copywriting skill's references/cold-read.md, one line saying who the reader is and where they meet the text, and the draft (as text or as a file path).

name: cold-reader
description: Reads a finished text with no other context and reports where a real reader could not follow. Use after drafting any PR description, design doc, proposal, README, email or Slack message, before anyone else sees it. Give it the file path and a one-line description of the reader. Never give it the session, a glossary or the author's intent.

name: cold-reader
description: Fresh-context reader that checks high-stakes audience-facing text (slides, talk scripts, papers, READMEs, docs, blog posts, release notes, PR descriptions) for spans its target audience cannot resolve, before the text goes out. Keeps review inputs read-only and writes one designated report. Reports quoted spans with audience questions and a NEEDS CONTEXT or PASS verdict; never rewrites.

name: cold-reader
description: Cold reader for the critique skill. Plays the reader in the brief, reads only the named files, and reports where each task stalls.

name: cold-reader-lens
description: Reviewer lens: reads code and tests with zero prior context. Verifies business language, naming clarity, and intent visibility.

name: cold-reader-prompt
description: Fill every `{slot}` before dispatch.

name: cold-reading-comparative
description: Cold reading at the comparative position. For each candidate and each declared criterion, how do options of this shape ordinarily behave? Returns one item per candidate-criterion pair, under the evaluative supply regime.

name: cold-reading-detection
description: Cold reading at the detection position. Where is the shipped tree in tension with the claim record? Returns tensions, each with the constraint in play and why it is a tension, under the registrative supply regime.

name: cold-reading-entailment
description: Cold reading at the entailment position. What does this design commit to, by being the kind of thing it is, that its articulation does not state? Returns surfaced claims, each with its claim type and what implies it, under the explicative supply regime.

name: cold-reading-widening
description: Cold reading at the widening position. Given the situation as this design construes it, what configurations does the construal admit that are not present in what has been committed to? Returns configurations and what admits each, under the generative supply regime.
